query: notifications is failing every request against the database but the other services are fine, is the database down
discriminator: One service fails 100% while the database is provably healthy and every other service that uses it is unaffected — so the fault is in how this service is configured to reach it, not in the database.

evidence.summary: recent errors: every one is 'An error occurred using the connection to database sentinel on server tcp://postgres-typo:5432' — the host it is trying is in the message and it is not the one the other services use
database health: PostgreSQL is accepting connections, 14 of 200 connections used, no errors — the database itself is fine
error rate in the last 30 minutes: notifications 100% on every database-backed route; orders, payments and users all 0% against the same database
response time in the last 30 minutes (ms): notifications p50=3054 — every request costs the same 3 second connect timeout before it gives up
container logs for sentinel-notifications: /health/ready has been returning 503 since the first failure, with the database check the only one failing
runbook configuration: every service reaches PostgreSQL through the same ConnectionStrings__Postgres variable; a host that differs between services is a deployment mistake
